content:
From today, iPhone users who have installed the Suno app can generate songs via text or voice commands using the Messages app. Here are the details.

Suno brings song generation to iMessage

Suno is one of the most popular AI song generation platforms, with over 2 million paid subscribers and 7 million songs generated daily.

In addition to its web platform, Suno also offers an iPhone app, allowing users to create and remix AI songs via text, recordings, or uploaded audio and video. The platform also provides features for users to compile song collections, curate edits, and browse playlists organised by music genre.

Now, Suno users can also create songs directly within Apple's Messages app. Once the Suno app is installed, it will appear in the Messages app's app drawer alongside other iMessage apps, allowing users to generate songs via text commands or voice memos without leaving the conversation.

Here's a demonstration of how the feature works in practice:

Suno says that users can select a music genre before generating a song, regenerate to explore different versions, and then send them into the conversation.

One possible limitation is that Suno notes both parties need to have the app installed to enjoy this feature. However, for users who enjoy experimenting with AI song creation, downloading this free app shouldn't pose too much of a barrier.

Download Suno from the App Store.
